racksFullQuotes.text: 🍲 Hassan cooked for the haven — meals stretched. The racks are already full (38,959 kcal kept — more than the haven can eat before it turns), so Hassan left the fresh pile for tonight's dinner instead of smoking it onto the rot pile.

workedQuoteFirst.text: 🍲 Pavel cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Pavel worked the smoke racks too — 2 batches preserved (~608 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).
